title: Cocktail Double Shaker Jigger Measuring Cup, 3.5in - Used
categoryName: Home & Garden:Kitchen, Dining & Bar:Kitchen Tools & Gadgets:Other Kitchen Tools & Gadgets
descriptionText: The Cocktail Drink Double Shaker Jigger Measuring Cup is a handy kitchen gadget measuring 3.5 inches in height. With a sleek design and precise measurements, this tool is perfect for bartenders or home mixologists looking to create professional-quality cocktails. The double shaker jigger allows for easy pouring and measuring of ingredients, making it a must-have for any home bar setup.
